name: Amane Yayoi
source:
School doctor of Kyoka Senior High School. Being one of the few people who [url=http://vndb.org/c1156]Hinata[/url] willingly associates with, she often acts as his confidant.

[spoiler]She is also Anu, the creator of net MMORPG "Babylon", and former leader of it's administering body "Anunnaki".[/spoiler]
